title: Dual-provider pool isolation and healthy smoke
prerequisites: Dedicated single-replica QA relay at reviewed source SHA; do not infer coverage from dogfood release 0.14.0.
Record live relay binary source SHA/checksum, coderd capability, active QA template version/module and runner CLI image digest, provider entitlements, config hash and org steven membership.

Resolve candidate baseline in config/baseline.json; verify provisioner process local Docker socket access and capacity, QA-only pools/queues, provider users' active org membership and both pool gauges equal 1.
Use this workspace's loopback /readyz and /metrics endpoints and an authorized reader through status UI /login. Capture baseline counters. Use unique run ID and only benign prompts.

variants.title: Claude healthy turn

steps.action: Select qa-claude in Claude Code with consenting steven QA user; send unique run-ID benign prompt and record provider session ID/time.
steps.expected: Session accepted by QA queue, not production.
steps.evidence: Redacted provider session ID and timestamp.

steps.action: Poll Coder workspace/build and private QA status/metrics every 15s; then send/observe one reply and poll runner metadata every 10s.
steps.expected: Successful build within 10m, connected runner within 2m of build, visible prompt reply; owner is requesting user in steven, provider=claude_code and build parameter agent_relay_pool=cc:qa-claude; no Cursor workspace matched or reaped.
steps.evidence: Workspace/build/version IDs, parameter name and nonsecret value, sanitized status and counter deltas.

cleanup: Close QA session, allow normal QA reap, and confirm workspace gone or record authorized manual cleanup disposition; never delete an unowned workspace.

variants.title: Cursor healthy turn and request logging

steps.action: Select coder-agent-relay-qa in Cursor from consenting steven QA user; send unique run-ID benign prompt; record request/claim ID and UTC time.
steps.evidence: Redacted request ID and UTC timestamp.

steps.action: Poll build every 15s up to 10m and runner metadata every 10s up to 2m after build; inspect one INFO pending-request-received event for the request and visible answer.
steps.expected: Successful build, connected runner and answer; owner in steven, agent_relay_pool=cur:qa-cursor, one INFO stream-delivered pending-request log if request actually arrived via stream (relist path need not emit it); no Claude crossover.
steps.evidence: Workspace/build IDs, sanitized INFO event/counter and pool parameter, redacted reply outcome.

cleanup: Close QA session and verify normal reap or record guarded manual cleanup disposition.

notes: If a provider or built feature is unavailable, mark that variant blocked or not-in-build, not pass.

Known legacy crossover risk: providerpool.PoolFilter still includes the bare pool name for both providers. Distinct baseline names qa-claude and qa-cursor do not test same-name legacy collisions; Q01 proves isolation only for newly stamped prefixed workspaces. Do not treat legacy crossover as passing or run a shared-pool collision fixture.
Image and dependency commits are covered only when the recorded build and runner image actually contain them; do not infer from version labels.
